text: agent1 (pricing.py) done. Committed decision PRICING_API v1 in shared/agreement_log.jsonl: get_item(sku)->dict|None {sku,name,price(float dollars),category}; get_customer(cust_id)->dict|None {id,name,discount(fraction, 0.10=10%),region}; list_items(); list_customers(). Money = float dollars, percents = fractions, not found = None. Tax rules and invoice logic are not in pricing.py.

agent2 (tax.py) done. Committed TAX_API v1 in shared/agreement_log.jsonl. Entry point: calculate_tax(lines, customer) -> int cents. lines = list of (category, amount_cents); customer = pricing.get_customer() dict (region, discount as fraction) or None (-> 0 tax). Helpers: dollars_to_cents(float) -> int, tax_rate_pct(region), is_exempt(category), taxable_amount_cents(lines). NOTE for invoice (agent3): tax.py uses team standard (integer cents, percent numbers, KeyError on miss). PRICING_API v1 is float dollars and discount fraction, so convert item prices with tax.dollars_to_cents(item['price']) before building lines. Unknown region raises KeyError. tax.py loads data_tax/ relative to the module file.

agent3 (invoice.py) done. render_invoice(order) uses PRICING_API v1 (get_item, get_customer) and TAX_API v1 (dollars_to_cents, calculate_tax(lines, customer), tax_rate_pct(region)). Money is converted to int cents; tax amount and rate come from tax.py only. Unknown customer: shown by id, 0% discount, calculate_tax(lines, None) -> 0 and 0%. Unknown region raises KeyError from tax.py and is not caught in invoice.py. Verified the spec example (MATCH) using stand-in pricing.py/tax.py in scratchpad, not the real modules; not yet tested against the real tax.py or pricing.py.
